notes: The accepted alignment folded the italicized 'and that' onto δημοσίᾳ. Rule 98 settles this shape the other way: the seam is asyndetic and joins two adverbs both rendered as adverbs, so the supplied juncture is added, and its governing precedent 2CO.3.7 concedes nothing.
The frame is kept as one added unit rather than split, both words being unlicensed parts of a single supplied connective, as ACT.18.18's 'after this' is kept whole.
